subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway-backed feature that sends browser microphone audio through an authenticated `audio.transcribe` RPC and configured media-audio providers?
rationale: The implementation direction is more aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting a new microphone-audio Gateway RPC is a product and security-boundary choice that code review alone should not authorize.

options.title: Continue after proof and port
options.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the P2 defects, and provide successful redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep the paired feature issue and this PR open while maintainers decide the permanent Control UI dictation boundary.

options.title: Supersede with a fresh implementation
options.body: Close or replace this branch if maintainers want the feature but prefer a new implementation on the current `ui/src/pages/chat` surface.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and port
recommendation.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the P2 defects, and provide successful redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest matching history from the merged server-side dictation implementation and is tied to the Gateway/UI boundary being reconsidered here.
